title: Catabolyst
extract:
Catabolyst is an  Infested sidearm that fires a short-ranged beam of  Corrosive bile. When reloading, the Catabolyst's clip is thrown like a grenade, with greatly increased potency if reloading from an empty clip.

Characteristics
This weapon primarily deals  Corrosive damage.
Primary beam:
Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 1.88% from 9m to 19m target distance. Distance is affected by Projectile Speed but do not increase the maximum range of the beam.
Consumes 0.5 ammo per tick of damage.
Damage ramps up from 20% to 100% over 0.6 seconds when firing. After firing stops for 0.8 seconds, the damage decays back to 20% over 2 seconds.
The zone of impact or maximum beam range has a spherical blast radius of 0.7 meters, bringing up the total range to 19.7 meters before mods, allowing it to hit multiple enemies at once.
Radial damage is not affected by multishot.
Radius is affected by  Fulmination ( Primed).
Reload throws a grenade at the reticle that explodes in 5 - 7 meter radius on impact with a surface or enemy.
Damage, critical chance, status chance, and explosion range increase when reloading with no ammo in the magazine.
Reload from empty has an innate -20% Reload Speed buff applied to it's base reload time of 1.7 seconds, increasing the time it takes to reload to 2.125 seconds.
Bonus is additive with  Quickdraw and similar bonuses.
Initial hit and explosion apply status separately.
Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
Has travel time.
Weapon must be completely emptied from a full magazine in order maximize the use of the grenade.
Radius is not affected by  Fulmination ( Primed).
Grenade is thrown mid-reload, interrupting the reload (e.g. with Self-stagger, or a Melee attack) will let you throw it again ad infinitum.
Can equip the Catabolyst-exclusive  Critical Mutation mod.
Innate  polarity.

Acquisition
The Catabolyst's blueprint can be researched from the Bio Lab in the dojo.

Notes
Will not reload automatically on an empty magazine, preserving the grenade. The player must manually reload the weapon to toss it out and refill the magazine.
Cannot throw the grenade if reserve ammo is completely depleted.
If reload is interrupted after throwing an empty clip, reloading again will throw a weaker grenade. This includes if the player is knocked back from a full magazine explosion.
The grenade throwing animation speed is affected by reload speed.
 Synth Charge increases the grenade damage.
Increasing magazine capacity has no effect on grenade damage.
Punch Through does not affect the beam or grenade.

Bugs
Multishot does not affect the reload grenade.
 Galvanized Shot is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits from thrown grenade in both empty and partially empty states.

Tips
Starting the reload animation and then rolling or interrupting the action throws the grenade without neither reloading the weapon nor consuming ammo, allowing for the grenade to be spammed over and over.
As this weapon has innate  Corrosive damage, very high status chance, and the primary fire uses very powerful beam Multishot mechanics, it is able to very effectively build into  Corrosive,  Viral, and either  Electricity or  Heat damage all at the same time. The first two procs tend to cap and provide their maximum bonuses almost instantly, while the single element Damage over Time effects will stack up dozens of procs. This makes the weapon extremely powerful against individual enemies.

Trivia
Its name is based on catabolysis, a biological process in which the body breaks down fat and muscle tissue for survival, which only occurs during extreme cases of malnutrition.
When tossing the empty magazine, the player appears shocked that a new one has grown in its place, even going so far as to act like they are going to replace it themselves only to realize it's full again.
The player will also grab a fully empty magazine and look at it before throwing, where partial reloaded magazines will simply be tossed quickly.
